# nain-mcp-validator

> A Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents deterministic 3D mesh validation (checks C1 to C10), SHA-256 content verification and fail-closed conformance reports.

## Links

- [Project page](https://mcp.naindev.com/): overview, tools and client setup
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/nain-mcp-validator): code, documentation and license (MIT)
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): main site of the author, Aitor Nain
